title: Analysis of LLM as a grammatical feature tagger for African American English

bias_targets.methodology: Logistic regression analysis to assess whether an LLM's prediction for a current sentence is significantly influenced by its predictions for the immediately preceding sentences within the same batch.

Logistic regression analysis to measure whether deviations from formal written English (such as excessive punctuation, missing subjects, or run-on sentences commonly found in transcribed oral speech) artificially increase the likelihood of the model predicting the presence of an African American English (AAE) grammatical feature.

Qualitative error analysis observing that the models conflate general non-standard English markers (e.g., the word "ain't" or general person-number disagreement) with specific, unrelated African American English grammatical structures like Habitual Be or Multiple Negation.
